description: This file implements a camera provider for the Android hardware abstraction layer (HAL) using the V2_7 interface. It manages a socket-based camera server, handles camera device lifecycle events, and provides camera interface methods such as getCameraIdList, setCallback, and device status notifications.

classes.name: VsockCameraProvider
classes.description: Implements the camera provider interface for V2_7, managing camera device lifecycle, callbacks, and server communication.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback for camera device status changes and manages connection setup.

methods.name: getVendorTags
methods.description: Returns an empty list as vendor tags are not supported.

methods.name: getCameraIdList
methods.description: Returns an empty list indicating no cameras are reported directly by the HAL.

methods.name: isSetTorchModeSupported
methods.description: Indicates that setting torch mode is supported, but no external camera with flash is available.

methods.name: getCameraDeviceInterface_V1_x
methods.description: Indicates HAL1 support is not available.

methods.name: getCameraDeviceInterface_V3_x
methods.description: Provides the camera device interface if the requested name matches the device name.

methods.name: notifyDeviceStateChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling device state changes.

methods.name: getConcurrentStreamingCameraIds
methods.description: Returns an empty list of concurrent camera ID combinations.

methods.name: isConcurrentStreamCombinationSupported
methods.description: Indicates that concurrent stream combinations are not supported.

methods.name: isConcurrentStreamCombinationSupported_2_7
methods.description: Indicates that version 2.7 specific concurrent stream support is not supported.

methods.name: deviceAdded
methods.description: Notifies that a device has been added and updates callbacks.

methods.name: deviceRemoved
methods.description: Notifies that a device has been removed and updates callbacks.
